closureRationale.HE-MA01: Corrected native assigns Recipient and expiry to bearer SubjectConfirmation. The assertion subject no longer expires. Explicit bearer method does not imply holder-of-key or prove possession of a cryptographic key. All prior verification, decryption, request-binding and only-then identity conditions remain intact in both application and broker memberships.
closureRationale.HE-MA02: Corrected native requires a granted authorization result before shell creation. All four fields in each of four current cases preserve first-hop authentication versus shell authorization, credential delegation and downstream resource ACL distinctions. Later denied operations do not contradict a separately authorized initial shell.
